g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Show Windows File Extensions and Identify
Double-Extension Files
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-23
Extensions identify file types
Microsoft Support explains that Windows file
names are divided into a name and an extension,
which is usually 3–4 characters long.
Turn on extension display: File
Explorer’s View menu
These are the steps for Windows 11. (1) Open
File Explorer. (2) Select View > Show at the
top. (3) Check “File name extensions.” After…
Check double extensions from the last
extension
A double extension is a name such as
invoice.pdf.exe, in which another extension
follows text that looks like a document…
Four checks before opening a file
① Last extension: If the ending extension is
executable, such as exe, msi, or bat, stop
before running the file. ② Sender: If you…
